body:
Dear [[NAME]],

The Office of the Attorney General is contacting you regarding a matter that requires your attention. Case reference [[REF]] was registered on [[DATE]].

This office has received a filing that involves your identity or financial information. You are required to verify your identity and respond to this notice to protect your legal rights.

Failure to respond may result in default proceedings. This is an official legal communication and must not be disregarded.
footer_text: Office of the Attorney General - Consumer Protection Division. Official correspondence.
